profile.name: basic-factions-pve-frost-npc-sources-v1

constructor.itemUid: U + preincrementing counter starting at zero

profile.runtime: Only cases kind=runtime use ordinary 50ms steps, normal NPC AI and validated enqueued client inputs after declared setup.
profile.helpers: Cases kind=helper-diagnostic/helper-recipients/helper-npc-bonus invoke the actual installed factions afterDamage system; engagement/mode, direct source constructors/lifecycle helpers and clock jumps are explicit diagnostic inputs, never ordinary runtime or client ability witnesses.
profile.map: declared-map-input.json cloned before createWorld; swap fire and frost zone identities/grids/spawnPool/region order exactly as code declares. extraSpots=true replaces the Frost camp spots pre-world with ten row-major positions (80+32*(i%4),80+32*floor(i/4)), except index5 is (208,112) to keep source spots distinct from the chest (112,112).
profile.consumables: omitted installer; the native config must set consumables=false
profile.abilities: installed installer; no ability producer is used in the bounded cases (asserted)
profile.lifecycle: engine patience/sudden-death timers not reached in the bounded window; no teleport or sudden-death event asserted
inert: abilities installer present but unused in these bounded cases
